asql: from orders where amount > 100 and status == 'completed' select id, amount

sql.postgres: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 AND status = 'completed'
sql.duckdb: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 AND status = 'completed'
sql.bigquery: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 AND status = 'completed'
sql.snowflake: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 AND status = 'completed'

asql: from orders group by region (sum(amount) as revenue, # as orders)

sql.postgres: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY region
sql.duckdb: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY region
sql.bigquery: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY region
sql.snowflake: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY region

asql: from orders group by region, status (sum(amount), avg(amount), #)

sql.postgres: SELECT region, status, SUM(amount) AS sum_amount, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS num FROM orders GROUP BY region, status
sql.duckdb: SELECT region, status, SUM(amount) AS sum_amount, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS num FROM orders GROUP BY region, status
sql.bigquery: SELECT region, status, SUM(amount) AS sum_amount, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS num FROM orders GROUP BY region, status
sql.snowflake: SELECT region, status, SUM(amount) AS sum_amount, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS num FROM orders GROUP BY region, status

asql: from orders where status == 'completed' group by region (sum(amount) as revenue) order by -revenue limit 10

sql.postgres: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
sql.duckdb: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
sql.bigquery: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
sql.snowflake: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

asql: from users select name, email order by name limit 5

sql.postgres: SELECT name, email FROM users ORDER BY name NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5
sql.duckdb: SELECT name, email FROM users ORDER BY name NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5
sql.bigquery: SELECT name, email FROM users ORDER BY name LIMIT 5
sql.snowflake: SELECT name, email FROM users ORDER BY name NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5
